agent-security.scope: Connect current write authority and exact approval to a paused workflow.
agent-security.observation: Two independent requests change the policy or bound amount before resumption and leave zero effects.

agent-recovery.scope: Separate permission to retrieve a committed receipt from permission to create an effect.
agent-recovery.observation: Read permission alone resolves a lost graph receipt. A denied lookup preserves pending confirmation while the original effect remains.

durable-workflows.scope: Follow one approval through durable wait, current authorization, committed effects and native process recovery.
durable-workflows.observation: Six real LangGraph/MCP cases preserve reopened checkpoints, current permissions, both MCP result channels and receiver effects. A stale approval policy control produces one rejected effect.

kairo-practice.scope: Map the demonstrated cases into the target platform acceptance contract.
kairo-practice.observation: Preserve approval and policy provenance, a separate receipt lookup, and receiver evidence. Execution remains an acceptance criterion for the target.

model-serving.scope: Hand off the same synthetic engine from sequential cache observations to an overlapping pair.
model-serving.observation: The prior real engine links directly to the new native queue and SSE timing record.

inference-performance.scope: Separate observed server queue transitions from client timing for the same two requests.
inference-performance.observation: Three pairs of real llama.cpp CPU runs use native task logs, measured metrics and 1,949 raw entries. The full token sequence and client timing can be recomputed.
